title: Scenario list produced by scenario-analyst
description: Every scenario must be derived from a concrete construct in the target code. the validate-scenarios command (bin/dtt) enforces this schema plus file/line existence checks; with a top-level request block it also checks the scenarios against that block. The validator does not read this file: scripts/dtt/cmd/validate_scenarios.py holds the same rules and both are kept in sync.

target.description: Project-relative path of the analyzed file, or Class / Class.Method.

scope.description: Optional. What the user asked for and what was left out because of it.

requested.description: The request in one line (analyst wording).

leftOut.description: Categories and counts of what was not covered, for example 'validation rules (3)'.

request.description: Optional. The user's request, written by the analyst. userText is the user's own words (the code cannot verify that); the other fields are its structured reading. Control, direction and separator characters are refused (a line feed is allowed in userText only).

file.description: Project-relative path of a target of the run.

form.description: grouped needs at least two cases for the same member, or count.max >= 2 with exactly one member target.

member.description: Method or property under test, e.g. DiscountCalculator.Apply

expectedBasis.description: Where the expected value comes from. Never 'observed output of the code'.

origin.description: Optional. 'user' = the scenario is one of the cases the user gave in the request (one scenario per case, in the given order).

group.description: Optional. Scenarios with the same group id become rows of one parameterized test (form: grouped). A group has 2 to 50 scenarios of the same member.

conflict.description: Optional, single line. The user's expected value is kept, but the input throws, is unreachable or contradicts the documentation (cite file:line or the XML doc).

existingTest.description: Optional, single line. An already existing test that covers the same member with the same input.
